title: TotemRefill
description: Automatically refills your offhand with a new Totem of Undying after one is used.
body:
TotemRefill is a simple client-side QoL mod that automatically places a new Totem of Undying into your offhand after your current one is used.

The mod is designed to stay out of your way. It does not put a totem in your offhand for no reason, and it will not fight against you when you manually remove one. If you take the totem out with F or move it from your inventory, TotemRefill leaves it alone. It only refills your offhand after a totem is actually used.

This makes it useful for PvP, crystal fights, hardcore worlds, survival challenges, and any situation where having another totem ready can save you. It is lightweight, automatic, and focused on doing one thing cleanly.
